## Choppy v1.31

📋⚡ Windows 10 / 11 - fast, clear file copier ⚡ everything that matters in one plain, dark window.

### What's in v1.31
- **A new copy comes up on top:** when a copy starts (or is added to the queue), Choppy's window appears above every other window, then goes back to normal stacking after a moment - it stays in front until you click something else.
- Small files on hard disks: one call less per file.

### Install / Update
1. Download **Choppy-v1.31.zip** and extract all files (or use the PowerShell one-liner from the README).
2. Double-click **Activate Choppy.cmd** (or run `build.ps1` and choose **[1]**).
3. Remove at any time with **Revert to Windows Copy.cmd**.
